A.title: Comparison between high-flow nasal cannula (HFNC) therapy and noninvasive ventilation (NIV) in children with acute respiratory failure by bronchiolitis: a randomized controlled trial
A.authors: Santos ACEZ, Caiado CM, Lopes AGD, et al.
A.why_table: The trial's main comparison table: counts, means, medians and p-values for two groups of 126 children. Simple statistics, but the Methods leave open how missing values, sedation and percentages are counted, and some rows were shared only as ranges.
glossary: the middle half of the values: from the lower to the upper quartile.
how likely a difference this large is by chance between the two groups.
age, weight and lengths of stay were shared only as ranges (such as 6-8 days), so those rows cannot be rebuilt.

B.title: Varied effects of tobacco smoke and e-cigarette vapor suggest that nicotine does not affect endothelium-dependent relaxation
B.authors: Wölkart G, Kollau A, Russwurm M, et al.
B.table: Table 2. Effects of CSE, EVE, and HTE on relaxation of rat aortas to acetylcholine and DEA/NO.
B.why_table: Maximal relaxation and EC50 for 12 treatments, from Hill-curve fits to each experiment, with geometric means and confidence limits. The fitting choices are exactly what Methods sections tend to leave out.
